clue.text: He accumulated great wealth, using various sources

instead of buying ready-to-wear, get the garment tailored to order

explanation.surface: Advice that wealth follows from getting one's clothes tailored rather than bought off the rack.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to be assured of success; literally it means to get something tailor-made.

clue.text: Quickly write a Spanish dance
